kev.note: Seven catalogue entries in the published CISA JSON schema, limited to the CVE IDs that appear in the demo fixtures. Dates, vendor and product labels and ransomware flags were transcribed on 2026-11-02 from public catalogue mirrors and CISA alert coverage because the build host had no route to cisa.gov. Fields that could not be confirmed were left out rather than guessed. `python3 -m exposure_radio feeds refresh` replaces this file with the complete catalogue.

epss.note: No EPSS snapshot is committed: the build host had no route to FIRST and scores are never transcribed from secondary sources. The loader reads the published FIRST CSV schema; `python3 -m exposure_radio feeds refresh` downloads the current file and the briefing then carries EPSS facts automatically.

tenable_research.note: Tenable Research publications that cover CVE IDs in the demo fixtures. Titles, dates and URLs were confirmed through web search on 2026-11-02; only tenable.com URLs are accepted by the loader.
